title: Custom Jersey Design (2026)
verdict: Custom jersey design in 2026 is free if you use Wooter. Send a brief and a designer returns a mockup in 1 to 2 business days. This page covers what to put in that brief so the first mockup is close.
Custom Ink offers design help for print on stock jerseys. Boombah, Champro and Nike Team rely mainly on builders and templates, the last two through dealers.
steps_title: Write a brief a designer can use

steps.name: Team name
steps.text: Spelled and capitalized as it should print.

steps.name: Colors
steps.text: Two or three, with codes if you have them.

steps.name: References
steps.text: Jerseys you like, and what you like about them.

steps.name: Limits
steps.text: League rules, sponsor requirements and anything to avoid.

why: A designer needs five things: the team name exactly as it should appear, colors, the logo file, two or three reference jerseys, and anything that is off limits.
Colors cause the most rework. Give codes if you have them. Navy means a dozen different blues to a dozen people.
For the logo, send the original file, not a screenshot. A vector file such as AI, EPS, SVG or PDF scales cleanly to the size of a jersey.

criteria.name: A clear brief
criteria.text: Name, colors, logo, references and limits.

faq.q: What file format should the logo be?
faq.a: Vector: AI, EPS, SVG or a vector PDF. If you only have a PNG, send the largest one and the designers can rebuild it.

faq.q: How do I describe a color accurately?
faq.a: Use a Pantone, hex or CMYK code. Without one, send a photo of something in the right color and expect a round of adjustment.

faq.q: How many reference jerseys should I send?
faq.a: Two or three, with a note on what you like about each.
Nothing at Wooter. You pay when you order.

faq.q: What if I do not like the first mockup?
faq.a: Say what to change. Nothing is produced until you approve a proof.
